AdminSettings.description: The Admin API and the dashboard.

listen.description: Address of the Admin API and the dashboard.

token_file.description:
File holding the Admin API token, created with a random token on first start if missing.
A relative path is resolved against `storage.data_dir`.

Certificate.description:
A certificate chain and its private key, read from PEM files. Relative paths are resolved
against the directory of the configuration file. The files are read again whenever the
configuration is applied, so that replaced files take effect on reload.

cert.description: PEM file with the certificate chain, leaf certificate first.

key.description: PEM file with the private key.

ConfigSettings.description: Where the dynamic settings come from.

source.description: Source of the dynamic settings: listeners, certificates and the other entity tables.

oneOf.description:
The database. Changes go through the Admin API or the dashboard and are kept as versions.
Dynamic settings in the configuration file are ignored.
The configuration file. Edit it and send SIGHUP to reload; the dashboard is read-only.

HttpSettings.description: HTTP settings of a listener. Settings left out follow the defaults of the running zora.

h2c.description:
Accept HTTP/2 without TLS from clients that start with it (prior knowledge), next to
HTTP/1.1. Only for listeners without TLS: those agree on HTTP/2 during the handshake
(ALPN). Default: `false`.

keepalive_timeout.description:
How long a kept-alive HTTP/1.1 connection, or an idle HTTP/2 connection, may wait for its
next request before it is closed, rounded up to whole seconds. `"0s"` turns HTTP/1.1
keep-alive off and closes idle HTTP/2 connections after one second. Default: `"75s"`, as
in Nginx.

Listener.description: A set of addresses served with one protocol.

listen.description: Addresses to listen on, such as `["0.0.0.0:443"]`.

tls.description: TLS termination. Without it the listener serves plain TCP.

certificates.description:
Names of the certificates the listener can present. The host name the client sends (SNI)
picks the certificate whose names cover it; when several do, the one listed first.

unknown_sni.description:
What to do when the client sends a host name that no certificate covers, or none at all.
Default: `"default"`.

level.description: Log filter in `tracing` directive syntax, such as `"info"` or `"info,zora_runtime=debug"`.

regex.description: Paths in which this regular expression finds a match; ^ and $ anchor it.

PathPattern.description: A path prefix such as "/api/", an exact path such as { exact = "/" }, or a regular expression such as { regex = "^/v[0-9]+/" }.

oneOf.description: HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, served by the gateway.

listeners.description: HTTP listeners whose requests the route sees. Without it, every HTTP listener.

match.description: Which requests the route takes. Without it, every request.

priority.description: Precedence over the other routes that match a request: higher first. Default: 0.

RouteMatch.description:
Conditions on a request. A request matches when it meets every condition that is set.

Paths are compared after normalization: every `%XX` decoded, `.` and `..` segments resolved
and repeated slashes merged, so that `/a/../admin/` and `/admin%2F` both count as paths
under `/admin/`.

headers.description:
Conditions on headers, by name: a value that one of the values of the header must equal,
`true` for a header that must be present, or `false` for one that must be absent.

hosts.description:
Host names, such as `example.com`, or `*.example.com` for one label in front of
`example.com`. Without it, any host.

methods.description: Methods, such as `["GET", "HEAD"]`. Without it, any method.

paths.description:
Paths: a prefix such as `"/api/"`, an exact path such as `{ exact = "/" }`, or a regular
expression such as `{ regex = "^/v[0-9]+/" }`. Without it, any path.

shutdown_timeout.description:
How long open connections may take to finish when zora shuts down or their listener is
changed or removed. Connections still open after that are closed.

threads.description: Worker threads of the data plane. `0` starts one per CPU core.

StorageSettings.description: Where zora keeps its database and runtime state.

data_dir.description:
Directory for the database and runtime state. A relative path is resolved against the
directory of the configuration file.

weight.description: Share of the requests relative to the other targets.

Target.description: A server of an upstream: its address, such as "10.0.0.1:8080", or a table with a weight.

UnknownSni.description: Handling of a TLS handshake for a host name that no certificate of the listener covers.

oneOf.description:
Present the first certificate of the listener, as Nginx presents the certificate of its
default server.

Fail the handshake, so that the certificates are not shown to clients that do not know a
host name they cover, such as scanners connecting by IP address.

Upstream.description: A group of servers that requests are balanced over.

targets.description:
The servers. Each request goes to the next one in turn, and a server with weight 2 gets
twice the share of one with weight 1.

admin.description: The Admin API and the dashboard. Static: a restart applies changes.

certificates.description:
TLS certificates by name. Dynamic: read from this file only when `config.source` is
`"file"`.

config.description: Where the dynamic settings come from. Static: a restart applies changes.

listeners.description: Listeners by name. Dynamic: read from this file only when `config.source` is `"file"`.

log.description: Logging. Static: a restart applies changes.

routes.description:
Routes of the HTTP listeners by name. Dynamic: read from this file only when
`config.source` is `"file"`.

server.description: Process settings. Static: a restart applies changes.

storage.description: Where zora keeps its database and runtime state. Static: a restart applies changes.

upstreams.description: Upstreams by name. Dynamic: read from this file only when `config.source` is `"file"`.

version.description: Version of the configuration format. This build reads version 1.
